job.title: Marketing Coordinator
job.description:
Land O'Lakes is looking for a Marketing Coordinator to support our consumer brands team.

What you'll do:
- Coordinate marketing campaigns across social, email and in-store channels
- Write copy for social media, emails and the website
- Track campaign performance in Google Analytics and report results
- Manage the content calendar and work with agencies on deadlines
- Support trade shows and events
- Manage marketing budgets and invoices

Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing or Communications
- 0-2 years of marketing experience, including internships
- Strong writing skills
- Experience with social media platforms and email tools
- Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite a plus
- Highly organized with attention to detail

professionalSummary.summary: Recent marketing graduate with internship experience in social media, email and event marketing.

achievements: Wrote and scheduled 60+ Instagram and Facebook posts over the summer
Grew Instagram followers by 2,400 in 3 months
Built 8 email campaigns in Mailchimp with a 41% average open rate
Helped plan and staff 4 taproom events with 300+ guests each
Created game-day graphics in Canva and posted live updates on X and Instagram
